facts.fact: Congo Digital Services published an 884-pair Lingala OCR image-text dataset for training a vision-language model, created in August 2026 with UNDP Congo and the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and the Digital Economy, under the NOODL-1.0 licence with gated access.

COG.note: No open data policy is stated.
The dataset is published by a company, not a public body.
